surface: Production Document, Page, Canvas, TextLayer, StructTree accessibility fallback, AnnotationLayer/forms, Thumbnail, Outline, PasswordResponses, LinkService, pdfjs, context hooks, render callbacks, refs, source/options handling, and the two CSS compatibility subpaths on pdfjs-dist 5.4.296.
divergences: The server export uses an inert PDF.js namespace so importing the package cannot evaluate browser-only DOMMatrix code; PDF work starts after hydration.
customTextRenderer HTML is sanitized before insertion instead of being injected verbatim.
Host callbacks receive native DOM events, with no synthetic text onChange layer.
ssr: Document and Page render deterministic no-data/loading/error shells without browser globals. Hydration adopts those hosts and starts source/document/page work after effects run.
notes: All source, document, page, canvas, text, structure-tree, annotation, outline, and destination async completions are instance-local and stale-guarded.
CSS compatibility entries vendor the focused upstream layer styles instead of duplicating PDF.js's full viewer stylesheet.
